column3: NKJV has “God is able,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Lord is able.”
NKJV includes “and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “died and rose and lived again,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “died and lived again.”
NKJV has “the judgment seat of Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “of God.”
NKJV includes “or is offended or is made weak,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends at “stumbles.”
